items.definition:
Not yet tested or proven.
The new software is still untested.

friendly and pleasant
She was an amiable person, always ready with a smile.

showing or feeling no interest, enthusiasm, or concern
Many voters have become apathetic about politics.

capable of being decomposed by bacteria or other living organisms
We should use more biodegradable packaging to protect the environment.

cheerful and lively
Despite the bad news, she remained remarkably chipper.

awkwardly large, heavy, or unwieldy
The old computer was slow and clunky.

mischievous, wicked
He gave a devilish grin before playing a prank.

unfaithful
His actions were seen as disloyal to the team.

having ears
The long-eared owl is a nocturnal bird.

made of earth or clay
They used earthen pots for cooking.

relating to the Iberian Peninsula (Spain and Portugal)
The Iberian Peninsula is located in southwestern Europe.

Not requiring much skill and lacking prestige.
He was tired of doing menial tasks all day.

having only one spouse or partner at one time
Many bird species are monogamous, forming lifelong pair bonds.

relating to the branch of medicine concerned with children and their diseases
She decided to specialize in pediatric medicine after medical school.

feasible, able to be done
The proposed solution is not economically practicable.

dark or dull in color or tone; gloomy
The mood in the room was somber after the bad news.

relating to or having the form of a symphony
The orchestra performed a beautiful symphonic piece.

not disputed or challenged
The election result was uncontested.

evil, wicked
The villainous character plotted against the hero.

large in volume, bulky
She wore a voluminous skirt to the party.

shaky, unstable, not straight
The table was a bit wonky, so we put a coaster under one leg.

effective against viruses
Doctors prescribed an antiviral medication to help fight the infection.

dark in color; dim
The dusky light of evening filled the room.

land left uncultivated for a period to restore its fertility
The farmer left the field fallow for a season.

of the same kind; uniform in structure or composition
The mixture was perfectly homogeneous after stirring.

most private, secret, or intimate
She shared her innermost thoughts with her best friend.

incapable of being dissolved; impossible to solve
The sugar was insoluble in cold water.

shy, reserved, or tending to focus on one's own thoughts and feelings
He's quite introverted and prefers quiet evenings at home.

having a stale, damp, or moldy smell
The old books in the attic had a musty smell.

relating to a peninsula
The peninsular region is surrounded by water on three sides.

safe to drink
The water from the spring is potable.

disreputable, squalid, or morally questionable
They met in a seedy bar on the outskirts of town.

sharply critical or sarcastic in a rude or disrespectful way
Her snarky comments often annoyed her colleagues.

old and torn; in poor condition
He wore a tattered coat to protect himself from the cold.

not joined or linked
The two events seemed completely unconnected.

below a healthy or normal weight
The doctor said the baby was slightly underweight.

not able to be found or noticed
The subtle changes were almost undetectable.

without being caused or provoked
The attack was completely unprovoked.

not interesting or special
His performance was rather unremarkable.

not able to be relied on as honest or truthful
He was considered untrustworthy after lying repeatedly.

(Of a person) large and strong; heavily built.
A burly man with a thick beard opened the door.

without protection; vulnerable
The small bird was defenseless against the hawk.

gloomy and drab; dull and dirty
The old hotel room was rather dingy and uninviting.

(of a vehicle) operating without a human driver
Driverless cars are becoming more common in some cities.

wildly excited or agitated
The crowd was in a frenzied state after the concert.

very unpleasant, bad, or shocking
The weather was frightful, with heavy rain and strong winds.

Of or relating to infants or infancy; childish.
His infantile behavior annoyed everyone in the meeting.

Moderate or average in size, amount, or rank
The restaurant received only middling reviews.

involving several million
He signed a multimillion-dollar deal.

slightly improper or risqué; lively
The comedian told a racy joke that made some people blush.

able to be received; due to be paid
The company has a large amount of accounts receivable.

impossible to understand
His speech became unintelligible after the accident.

not arranged or structured
Her desk was completely unorganized, with papers everywhere.

relating to or involving acrobatics
The gymnast performed an acrobatic routine.

preventing the growth of disease-causing microorganisms
She cleaned the wound with an antiseptic wipe.

relating to the cornea of the eye
He suffered a corneal abrasion after getting dust in his eye.

able to be defended or justified
His actions were not morally defensible.

stubbornly resisting change or discontinuation
He's a die-hard fan of the local football team.

abrupt or surly in manner or speech
Despite his gruff exterior, he was a kind man.

Fit to be seen or introduced; well-dressed or groomed
After a quick shower, he felt much more presentable for the meeting.

(Of food) salty or spicy rather than sweet
I prefer savory snacks over sweet ones.

Covered with or resembling scales
The fish had rough, scaly skin.

Covered or marked with small spots or patches of color
The bird had speckled feathers.

not receiving enough services or support
The new clinic aims to help the underserved community.
